record.name: Weekly team sync
lines: Hi everyone, can you hear me?
Great. Anna is joining in a minute.
No problem, we can wait for her.
Let's start with the release. Are we on track for Thursday?
Mostly. The payment flow is done. The invoices export still needs a review.
Igor can. I'll ask him right after this call.
Good. Next, Acme asked for single sign-on. Can we offer it this quarter?
Maybe. Maria needs to estimate it first.
Maria, can you send the estimate by Monday?
Yes, I'll send it on Monday.
Last thing: support needs the release notes before Wednesday.
Anna will send them on Tuesday.
